original_description: The Altiora Codex Oracle is a digital environment for personal, spiritual, and creative reflection. Users can open one-card, three-card, or five-card readings and, for multi-card readings, choose between a Full Reading, Core Message, or Personal Transmission. The Oracle supports both English and Dutch, and readings can be saved as a document or PDF. It is intended for personal reflection and inspiration and does not replace medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
summary_ja: 英語・オランダ語でカードリーディングを行い、個人の内省や着想に使う。結果は文書やPDFに保存できると説明。
limitations: 個人の内省や着想向けで、専門家の助言に代わらないとの説明。実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
